mutatedIconPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / minimalist game UI icon.
Reference: the provided two-icon sheet is the user's SELECTED style. LEFT is now "原生" (native), RIGHT is now "觉醒" (awakened). Design ONE NEW THIRD TYPE ICON "变异" (mutated / TWO BLOODLINES), extending this exact simple abstract DNA icon family. Output ONLY the new third icon on real transparent RGBA.
Primary request: mutation means TWO animal bloodlines fused. Depict TWO COMPLETE, equally prominent DNA HELIX MOTIFS intertwined as ONE compact emblem. Both genetic sources must be readable at thumbnail size: two top entry lobes and two internal negative-space gene-core openings. The two helixes weave together at their middle/lower strands. At most two broad ladder rungs per source, no microscopic DNA detail. This is a paired-helix glyph, NOT one helix with a small decorative appendage. Preserve a SINGLE compact LIGHTNING motif at the upper right in the exact angular style of the reference right icon, so this visibly inherits the awakened state. The lightning must stay secondary to the paired bloodline body and must not become the main silhouette. No second lightning bolt.
Match the reference's broad, tapered, angular interlacing ribbons, slightly softened corners, generous negative-space channels, and sparse graphic construction. Stroke thickness should look close to the reference at the same visual height; simplify the pair instead of making very thin lines. Mutated total body should read as about 1.4 times the width of the native helix but the same height, and it should still fit in a compact square icon. Clearly retain TWO complete recognizable helix sources, not one wide helix or one four-stranded braid with no distinguishable sources.
Flat solid warm graphite gray #706F68, fully opaque shape interiors, clean antialiased edges. Absolutely no animal heads, ears, faces, claws, wings, crests, heraldry, outer circle, shield, badge, decorative border, star, gradient, glow, shadows, bevels, texture, text, numbers or rank chevrons. We are returning to the simple abstract DNA language the user selected, not the previous animal-head version.
Canvas square about1024x1024, single centered glyph including the bolt within a 700x700 bounding square, with wide transparent margins all around. ACTUAL transparent alpha background, not black/white fill, not checkerboard. No original two icons in this output: only the new mutated dual-bloodline icon.
